description:
An uploaded model in another format ('step', 'stl', 'obj' or '3mf'), as Cliff CAD exports it, without planning
    it: STEP to a mesh, a mesh to STEP. Native CAD (SolidWorks, ...) is not read: export STEP from your CAD. Returns the new file (its links.content has the bytes). A mesh made into
    STEP stays faceted. Needs an API key. Saved to this computer, its `path` returned, unless save_to is ''.

save_to.description: A folder on this computer to save the file in (default: CLIFF_MCP_DOWNLOADS, else ~/Downloads/Cliff). Set save_to to an empty string to only get the link.

name: convert_file
